create_optimizer: create an optimizer with per-network learning rates for lipreading, facial, unet, and vocal networks
display_val: display validation loss metrics for mix-and-separate, co-separation, and crossmodal losses
get_mixandseparate_loss: compute mix-and-separate loss from predicted and ground-truth spectrogram masks with weights
get_coseparation_loss: compute co-separation triplet loss between audio embeddings of separated sources
get_crossmodal_loss: compute crossmodal triplet loss between audio embeddings and facial identity features
